summary: The study describes the synthesis of a bifunctional electrocatalyst, Co9S8/CNT, using atomic layer deposition (ALD) to coat carbon nanotubes (CNTs) with a uniform layer of Co9S8. The ALD-synthesized Co9S8/CNT catalyst demonstrates excellent electrocatalytic performance for both oxygen evolution reaction (OER) and oxygen reduction reaction (ORR), making it a promising candidate for high-performance rechargeable Zn-air batteries. The ALD technique allows for precise control over the coating thickness and uniformity, enhancing the catalytic activity and stability of the material.
evidence: The ALD of Co9S8 was performed at 120 °C for 200 cycles, using bis( N,N’ -diisopropylacetamidinato)cobalt(II) and H2S as the precursors. The ALD-synthesized Co9S8/CNT catalyst displayed remarkable electrocatalytic performance with excellent catalytic activity and stability toward both OER and ORR.
